submittedPrompt: 制作完整回收站中文UI图。完整主人桌面DooKnow页，约1440×1000。图1是真实内容/状态/宿主几何，图2只给共享平面配色/密度。在顶部保留DooKnow书本标识 | 笔记的共享横页头；窄owner rail为O账户、笔记/最近/收藏/应用，底部回收站/设置；保留知识侧栏搜索笔记与目录、新建分裂按钮、笔记本plus/刷新、目录树及resize。只用现有控件，不虚构导航。顶部共享header上下文回收站，rail回收站选中。知识侧栏保持图1正常两目录。主区小字知识库管理、主标题回收站、副文笔记和文件夹均可恢复，保留原笔记标识；原位置被占用时，可以更换名称。，右上返回笔记。搜索回收站空输入placeholder按原路径或文件名查找；本页文件状态select全部状态；查找和刷新列表可用。选择栏全选本页可读取项目unchecked且禁用，本页0项 · 已选0项；恢复所选/永久移除所选文件均禁用。中央回收站为空、删除的笔记和文件夹会显示在这里。。分页上一页/下一页禁用，第1页。底部完整说明文件夹支持整体恢复，暂不支持永久移除。永久移除仅针对所选回收站原文件，无法在此恢复；历史版本、备份及必要的元数据仍按各自的保留规则保存。无虚构文件/恢复成功/重命名/确认弹窗或未知大小日期。统一平面白/浅灰、#272b3a正文、#657084次级、#e6e9f1细线、#4566c6蓝色、#edf1ff选中，清晰紧凑中文无衬线、8px圆角。无纹理渐变、浏览器外壳、开发说明或协议字段输入。metadata保留其他状态合同。

sourceContracts.title: Trash workspace page
permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

locked=busy||pendingRequest||purgeDraft; locks selection/search/pagination/new restore/purge while operation or confirmation pending. Only available items selectable; folder restore supported, folder purge unsupported.
Management route checks ownerId exists in user table. Batch IDs1–100 unique, /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/; requestId nonempty<=128 and no control characters.

fields.name: 搜索回收站
fields.constraints: maxLength200; trimmed query filters original path/file name on server.

fields.name: 本页文件状态
fields.constraints: all | available | unavailable; filters current page only and clears selection.

fields.name: 选择项目 / 全选本页
fields.constraints: Only readable items on current loaded page; page size50 UI; server limit1–100; selection resets on page load.

actions.label: 查找 / 刷新列表 / 上一页 / 下一页
actions.effect: Load signed-cursor page and new confirmation snapshot

actions.label: 恢复所选 / 恢复并打开 / 恢复文件夹
actions.effect: Restore selected originals preserving note identity; only note restore opens editor
actions.guard: Current page available items; !locked&&!loading; optional per-id replacement base names

actions.label: 更换文件名/文件夹名
actions.guard: Authenticated owner; current note/session guards apply.

actions.label: 永久移除文件 / 永久移除所选文件
actions.guard: Selection nonempty, available and contains no folders

actions.label: 返回笔记
actions.guard: Authenticated owner; current note/session guards apply.

responsive.behavior: Workspace max-width1100px, padding32px clamp(18px,4vw,48px)64px.<=743px search wraps, batch actions full width and item actions move below title;<=420px item buttons flex, rename input wraps and results stack. Actual320/390/1440 fit unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated PNG viewed against all input images and exact source template/conditional state contracts.
concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
Actual empty first page has zero selections; batch restore/purge, select-all and previous/next are disabled. Item/rename/purge confirmation variants remain separate contracts.
